scheme_name: Assistance Towards Expenses Incurred for Raising of Funds through NSE’s/ BSE’s SME Exchange Platform
description:
The Assistance Towards Expenses Incurred for Raising of Funds through NSE’s/ BSE’s SME Exchange Platform is a government welfare scheme initiated by the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) in India.

This scheme was launched on 1st October 2021.

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to small and medium enterprises that are looking to raise capital through the SME exchange platforms of the National Stock Exchange (NSE) and the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE).

The scheme aims to facilitate the growth of MSMEs by enabling them to access the capital markets.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is intended to cover the expenses incurred during the process of raising funds.

Eligible MSMEs can receive assistance of up to ₹50 lakh.

This assistance can be utilized for various expenses including underwriting fees, legal fees, and other associated costs.

The scheme is designed to encourage MSMEs to tap into the capital markets for their funding needs.

The target beneficiaries of this scheme are small and medium enterprises that meet the criteria set by the MSME Development Act of 2006.

To qualify for the scheme, an enterprise must have an investment in plant and machinery not exceeding ₹10 crore for manufacturing enterprises.

For service enterprises, the investment limit is set at ₹5 crore.

The applicant must be a registered MSME with a valid Udyog Aadhaar registration.

The application process involves several steps to ensure that the enterprises meet the eligibility criteria.

First, the applicant must prepare a detailed project report outlining the purpose of raising funds and the expected outcomes.

Next, the applicant must submit the project report along with the application form to the concerned MSME department.

The application form requires specific details such as the name of the enterprise, registration number, and the amount of assistance requested.

Additionally, the applicant must provide documents such as the Udyog Aadhaar registration certificate, financial statements for the last three years, and a detailed breakdown of the expenses to be incurred.

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the MSME department.

The department will assess the eligibility of the enterprise and the viability of the project.

If approved, the financial assistance will be disbursed in a single installment.

The disbursement is typically made within 30 days of approval.

The scheme is applicable for enterprises that are planning to raise funds through the SME exchange platforms.

The assistance can be availed only once by an enterprise under this scheme.

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India.

The MSME Development Institutes across various states are responsible for the execution of the scheme.

These institutes provide guidance and support to MSMEs in the application process.

They also assist in the preparation of project reports and financial statements.

The scheme is part of the broader initiative by the Indian government to promote entrepreneurship and enhance the competitiveness of MSMEs.

The government recognizes that access to finance is a critical barrier for MSMEs in India.

By facilitating access to capital markets, the scheme aims to empower MSMEs to grow and expand their operations.

The scheme is expected to enhance the overall contribution of MSMEs to the Indian economy.

As of October 2023, the MSME sector contributes approximately 30 percent to India’s GDP.

It also accounts for around 45 percent of the total manufacturing output.

The government has set a target to increase the number of MSMEs accessing capital markets through this scheme.

The aim is to increase the number of MSMEs listed on the NSE and BSE by 25 percent by the end of 2025.

The scheme is aligned with the government's vision of making India a $5 trillion economy.

The MSME sector plays a crucial role in achieving this vision by creating jobs and fostering innovation.

The government has also introduced other initiatives to support MSMEs, including the Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme and the PM Employment Generation Programme.

These initiatives complement the assistance provided under the SME exchange platform scheme.

The government is committed to ensuring that MSMEs have the necessary resources to thrive in a competitive market.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is a step towards achieving that goal.

The scheme is expected to benefit thousands of MSMEs across the country.

It provides a much-needed financial cushion for enterprises looking to expand their operations.

The government encourages eligible MSMEs to take advantage of this scheme.

By doing so, they can reduce their financial burden and focus on their core business activities.

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to supporting the growth of the MSME sector in India.

It reflects the understanding that MSMEs are vital for economic development and job creation.

The assistance towards expenses incurred for raising funds through NSE’s/ BSE’s SME Exchange Platform is a significant initiative.

It aims to bridge the funding gap faced by small and medium enterprises.

The scheme is expected to foster a culture of entrepreneurship in India.

It encourages MSMEs to explore new avenues for funding and growth.

The government continues to monitor and evaluate the impact of this scheme on the MSME sector.

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme further.

The assistance provided under this scheme is a crucial element in the larger framework of MSME support initiatives.

It highlights the importance of access to finance in driving economic growth and development.

The Ministry of MSME remains dedicated to enhancing the ecosystem for small and medium enterprises in India.

This scheme is one of many efforts to ensure that MSMEs can thrive and contribute to the nation's economy.
